content.title: Leave the show by 10:40 pm for the last eastbound train

body.text:
The Green Line operator posted at 9:12 pm: "Only the 11:40 pm eastbound is canceled. Last eastbound is 10:55 pm. Westbound service is on schedule." https://wirewalk.example/@green-line-ops/posts/p19
The last eastbound train now leaves Fennick St at 10:55 pm. Fennick St is a 15-minute walk from Quillfeather Hall and the concert ends at 11:00 pm, so leave by 10:40 pm.
